# FinLead AI

> FinLead AI is an AI-native platform that deploys AI agents to run insurance operations for insurers, brokers, agencies, MGAs and other distributors. The agents handle complex back-office tasks with intelligence, speed and accuracy. Positioning: "We don't sell seats. We own the outcome."  BPO economics, software margins.

## What FinLead AI does
- Deploys autonomous AI agents that complete insurance back-office work end-to-end with human in the loop process, rather than only assisting humans.
- Serves insurers, brokers, agencies, MGAs and distributors globally.
- Pricing is tied to the work displaced, not per-seat.

## Target audience
- Insurance finance teams that reconcile carrier statements, expected commission, payout rules and exceptions.
- Insurance operations teams that process statements, policies, bordereaux files, producer onboarding and back-office exceptions.
- Distribution, MGA, broker and agency leaders who need cleaner producer activation, performance visibility and payout control.
- Insurance executives evaluating outcome-based AI agents instead of seat-based SaaS tools or generic AI chatbots.

## Agent suites
- Finance Ops: Commission Reconciliation (match carrier statements, flag tax/rate mismatches, reconcile precisely); Statement & Policy Extraction (unstructured carrier PDFs and portals into clean queryable data); Payout Calculation (compute payouts against rules and cycles with a full audit trail).
- PoSP & Distribution: Agent Onboarding (verification, licensing checks, activation); Agent Analysis (performance, persistency, productivity); Agent Intelligence (who to coach/reward, where the next premium comes from).
- Intelligence: Leakage Analysis (detect leakage across commissions, payouts and claims); Profitability Guardrails (measure every payout against profit); Corrective Insight (recommend changes to rates, rules and controls to recover margin).

## Blog and briefing topics
- The FinLead Briefing is the public blog for insurance operations, AI agents and back-office workflow guidance.
- Blog posts are written for human operators first: simple English, practical headings, clear definitions and concrete workflow advice.
- Blog posts should help readers understand commission reconciliation, insurance AI agents, producer onboarding, insurance revenue leakage, bordereaux processing and related operations topics.
- Each blog post has its own public URL, article metadata, FAQ schema, breadcrumb schema, keywords, canonical URL and shareable link.
- FAQs and structured metadata are provided to make articles easier for search engines and AI systems to understand, but the visible page should stay concise and reader-friendly.
